name: kampaku
description: Kampaku — a personal software factory: control plane, workers, operator UI, and contracts for building software in any language, project type, or architecture

scripts.build: cd apps/worker && npm run build && cd ../web && npm run build && cd ../core && npm run build
scripts.test: cd apps/worker && npm test && cd ../web && npm test && cd ../core && npm test
scripts.test:coverage: cd apps/worker && npm run test:coverage && cd ../web && npm run test:coverage && cd ../core && npm run test:coverage -- --exclude='**/eval/**'
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/worker && npm run typecheck && cd ../core && npm run typecheck
